description: Search the public LinkedIn Learning catalog by keyword, filter by level, type, length, software and sort order, or read specific course, learning-path and chapter URLs. No login or cookie is required.

assetType.description: Kind of learning content. 'All types' mixes courses, learning paths and videos.
assetType.title: Asset type

difficultyLevel.description: Filter by skill level. 'All levels' returns every level.
difficultyLevel.sectionDescription: Server-side filters from LinkedIn Learning's own catalog. They apply only in search mode (and to search URLs in URL mode).
difficultyLevel.title: Difficulty level

duration.description: Filter by total course length. 'Any length' returns every length.
duration.title: Time to complete

includeDetails.description: Open each record's public page for description, skills, syllabus, chapters, free-preview flags, reviews, rating, learner count, provider and certificate. Turn off for a faster, cheaper catalog snapshot.
includeDetails.sectionDescription: Detail enrichment and optional connection settings.
includeDetails.title: Include full course details

maxResults.description: Maximum records per query (or per URL list in URL mode). LinkedIn's guest catalog exposes at most 50 cards per filter slice; the actor re-runs the query across its own filters to collect more.
maxResults.title: Max results per query

mode.description: What to collect. 'Search the catalog' needs searchQuery. 'Read specific URLs' needs urls. 'Browse learning paths' reads the public all-paths page.
mode.title: Mode

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The actor connects directly by default and only escalates to a datacenter proxy if LinkedIn blocks a request. Change this only if you need a specific proxy setup.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

searchQuery.description: Keyword or skill to search for, e.g. 'Python machine learning' or 'project management'. Put one query per line to run several searches in one run; each line is labelled in the output.
searchQuery.title: Search query

software.description: Keep only content that teaches this LinkedIn Learning software label, e.g. 'Python', 'Microsoft Excel', 'SQL' or 'ChatGPT'. LinkedIn applies only one software label per request.
software.title: Software

sortBy.description: Order of the results: LinkedIn's best match, view count, or newest release.
sortBy.title: Sort by

topic.description: Optional words appended to every search query to narrow it, e.g. 'AWS' or 'for beginners'.
topic.title: Extra keywords

urls.description: Course, learning-path, chapter/lesson, topic or filtered search URLs. Used only in 'Read specific LinkedIn Learning URLs' mode.

url.description: LinkedIn Learning course, learning-path, chapter/lesson, topic or filtered search URL.
url.title: URL

urls.title: LinkedIn Learning URLs

title: LinkedIn Learning Catalog Input
